verdict.rationale: Crossplane is an infrastructure control-plane tool, so built-in AI code generation is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no natural-language-to-configuration generation in its CLI or toolchain. Its only AI mentions say AI agents can consume or act on declarative APIs, which is a different capability from generating infrastructure code.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate infrastructure code from natural language using AI assistance built into the toolchain
